title: DisasterVQA: A Visual Question Answering Benchmark Dataset for Disaster Scenes

bias_targets.methodology: Comparing model performance (accuracy and F1-scores) on visual question answering tasks across different global regions (Africa, Europe, Middle East, North America, South America, South Asia, Southeast Asia) to identify regional disparities in reasoning capabilities.

Evaluating the models' resistance to false positives and semantic over-interpretation by testing them on a 'hard-negative' subset of non-disaster images that share chaotic visual textures or elements (e.g., construction sites, fireworks) to see if they default to hallucinating disaster scenarios.
